plugins.name: tia-portal-openness-mcp
plugins.description: Automation Engineering Workbench (formerly TIA Portal Openness MCP): an MCP server for Siemens TIA Portal Openness — runtimes for V14 SP1, V15.1, V16, V17, V18, V19, V20 and V21, plus skills. Selects the newest installed TIA release, then the newest runnable bundled host.
